title: Mahavira Swami ne shmashan mein raat kaise bitaayi?
hooks: Raat 12 baje, shmashan mein ek aadmi khada tha. Hila tak nahi.
Ek Yaksha ne aag, bhoot, apna vikaaral roop — sab dikhaya. Kuch nahi hua.
Barah saal ki tapasya ka sabse kathin imtihaan — ek raat mein.
hook_why: Opens with a specific, relatable image (midnight, cremation ground, one unmoving figure) — no jargon, instant visual curiosity. Matches the channel's calm-but-gripping style.
metaphor: A lotus in fire — but shown as: Mahavira's mind is a screen. Fear plays on it like a movie. He watches. Doesn't become the movie. That gap = samata.

cast.Mahavira: Mahavira Swami as serene meditating figure in standing kayotsarga, white marble texture, lion emblem on chest, half-closed eyes, soft saffron-gold rim light, uncluttered background
cast.Yaksha: Yaksha as ethereal luminous being — starts human-like 7ft tall, saffron glow, celestial jewelry. At climax: limbs stretch 40%, height doubles, aura flares to blinding gold, face splits into three calm expressions

scenes.vo: Raat 12 baje. Shmashan. Ek aadmi khada tha — hila tak nahi.
scenes.prompt: Night cremation ground, dark indigo sky, faint stars, low funeral pyres glowing. Mahavira standing center in kayotsarga, white marble form, lion emblem, soft saffron-gold rim light. Far Jain temple silhouette. Painterly Indian style, calm, uncluttered. Text zone: top third free for hook caption.

scenes.vo: Barah saal ki tapasya. Yeh ek raat — sabse bhaari imtihaan.
scenes.prompt: Close on Mahavira's face — half-closed eyes, marble pores visible, single saffron light thread on forehead. Breath invisible. Background cremation ground blurred to bokeh. Painterly, serene. Text zone: lower third free.

scenes.vo: Ek Yaksha aaya. Dekhna chahta tha — isko darr lagta hai kya?
scenes.prompt: Yaksha materializing from shadow — human silhouette, 7ft tall, saffron luminescence, ornate jewelry with lace patterns, floating 2ft above ash. Eyes curious, not malicious. Mahavira unmoved in foreground. Painterly Indian style. Text zone: right side free.

scenes.vo: Pehle aag uthi — lehren charanon tak. Mahavira ne dekha: sirf roshni, koi khatra nahi.
scenes.prompt: Flames rising from pyres into serpentine waves, crawling toward Mahavira's feet — stylized saffron-gold strokes like miniature painting. Flames part like water around his marble feet. Mahavira's POV inset: fire seen as pure light, no threat label. 8s loop. Painterly motion.

scenes.vo: Phir bhoot-pret naache — vikrit chehre, bhayanak aawazen. Mahavira ne dekha: sirf aakaar, koi asliyat nahi.
scenes.prompt: Ghostly figures dancing in circle — elongated limbs, hollow eyes, silent screams. Translucent indigo-white washes, 2px ink outlines, tattered cloth with lace texture. Mahavira center, still as axis. His POV inset: forms seen as empty shapes. Painterly uncanny. Text zone: top free.

scenes.vo: Yaksha phaila — aakash tak uchha, teen chehre, blind saffron aura. Mahavira ne dekha: sirf badla hua roop, koi shakti nahi.
scenes.prompt: Yaksha expanding — limbs stretch 40%, height doubles touching sky, saffron aura flares to blinding gold, jewelry multiplies into mandala rings, face splits into three calm expressions. Clouds swirl. Mahavira tiny below, unmoved. His POV inset: giant form seen as just larger shape. 8s transformation. Painterly scale shift.

scenes.vo: Yahi toh hai samata — darr aaya, par usne usse 'dekha' bas. Reaction nahi diya.
scenes.prompt: A serene white marble texture with subtle carved lace border, a single lotus flower in saffron-gold at bottom center, soft glow, minimal and calm, plenty of negative space in center for text overlay. No text, no letters, no logos.

scenes.vo: Yaksha ka ghamand toota. Sir jhukaya, pranaam kiya — 'tum jeete.'
scenes.prompt: Yaksha kneeling — massive form folded small, forehead touching ash near Mahavira's feet. Saffron glow now gentle, jewelry dimmed to humble gold, hands folded in anjali. Mahavira unchanged. Lotus petals falling. Painterly surrender. Text zone: top free.

scenes.vo: Baahar kuch bhi ho — aag, bhoot, raakshas. Bheetar shant. Yeh seekha sakte ho.
scenes.prompt: Wide shot — colossal Yaksha looming, Mahavira marble speck at center. Saffron light beam on Mahavira alone. Yaksha's three faces show wonder. Carved temple architecture frames edges. Painterly contrast. Text zone: lower third free.

scenes.vo: Agla baar darr aaye — tum kya karoge? Dekhoge? Ya daboge? Jai Jinendra.
scenes.prompt: Siddhashila crescent glowing soft gold on white marble. Lotus blooming at center. Mahavira's footprints faintly etched below. Saffron light rays spreading. 'Jai Jinendra' in elegant Hindi calligraphy floating. Serene painterly end frame. Uncluttered.

caption: Raat 12 baje, shmashan mein Mahavira khade the. Yaksha ne aag, bhoot, vikaaral roop — sab dikhaya. Mahavira ne sirf 'dekha'. Reaction nahi diya. Yahi hai samata: baahar kaandhe, bheetar shant. Agla baar darr aaye — tum kya karoge? Jai Jinendra.

claims.claim: Mahavira spent a night in a cremation ground during his 12-year ascetic period and was tested by a Yaksha with terrifying illusions.
claims.basis: Kalpasutra (Lives of the Jinas) and Jain tradition — standard episode of Mahavira's kayotsarga in shmashana tested by a deity/spirit.

claims.claim: Mahavira remained in unmoving standing meditation (kayotsarga) throughout, displaying perfect equanimity (samata).
claims.basis: Core Jain principle — Tirthankaras embody samata; this episode is cited as a paramount example in Jain texts.

claims.claim: The Yaksha ultimately bowed in reverence, recognizing Mahavira's spiritual attainment.
claims.basis: Kalpasutra narrative pattern — deities/spirits test then submit to Tirthankaras (e.g., Indra's tests, Chamara Yaksha).
